Transitions as a list
  • Idle to Boost: |a| > 3 g for 200 ms
  • Boost to Coast: |a| < 1.5 g 2 samples
  • Coast to Apogee: launch confirmed, v < −2 m/s
  • Apogee to Descent: after 1 s
  • Descent to Landed: still 3 s, barometer within 3 m
  • Boost or Coast back to Idle: barometer not 5 m up within 1.43 s, then still 1 s: launch withdrawn
